files.description: The complete (b)(10) EHI Export documentation page. Contains two sections: Provider Export (workflow diagram + bulk data list) and Patient Export Requests (FHIR DocumentReference mention + same bulk data list). This is the entirety of CloudCraft's public EHI export documentation.
Full-page browser screenshot of the B10.html page showing both sections, the workflow diagram with five steps, and the bulk data lists.
Workflow diagram icon: 'Patient(s) submit requests' — shows people with a checklist, step 1 of the provider export workflow.
Workflow diagram icon: 'Access Bulk Download From Admin Console' — shows a document with download arrow, step 2 of the provider export workflow.
Workflow diagram icon: 'Select Patients requesting Primary care provider Access' — shows a document with checkmark, step 3 of the provider export workflow.
Workflow diagram icon: 'User selects secure Download location' — shows a document with magnifying glass, step 4 of the provider export workflow.
Workflow diagram icon: 'User give provider Secure access' — shows a document with checkmark/shield, step 5 of the provider export workflow.
Arrow connector between workflow steps in the provider export diagram.
CloudCraft logo displayed in the page header.
